name: list_forms
description: List the forms in this workspace with their endpoint URLs and hosted page URLs. No submission data.

name: list_templates
description: Form templates (contact, feedback, registration, ...) with their field lists. Pass a template slug to create_form to start from one.

name: create_form
description: Create a form. Returns the endpoint URL to POST submissions to. The notification address gets a verification email automatically; notifications are held until the owner confirms it. Pass either `fields` (array of {name,label,type,required}) or a `template` slug, or neither for name/email/message.

orgId.description: Workspace id. A paired agent key defaults to its own workspace and may omit this; a classic API key must pass one of the orgId values that list_forms returns.

name.description: Shown in the dashboard, e.g. 'Website contact'.

hosted.description: Also publish a hosted page at formward.eu/s/... (no code needed).

redirectUrl.description: Thank-you page after a classic POST.

allowedOrigins.description: Site origins allowed to submit, e.g. https://example.com.

name: get_form_snippet
description: Paste-ready form markup for one form with its real endpoint. tech is one of: html, react, tailwind, shopify, webflow, vue, svelte, astro, nextjs, nuxt.

name: get_form_stats
description: Submission counts and the time of the latest submission for a form. Use after sending a test to confirm it arrived. Never returns submission content.

name: list_webhooks
description: Webhook destinations configured on a form (no secrets).

name: add_webhook
description: Add a webhook (generic, Slack or Discord) that fires on each submission. Professional plan and above; https URLs to public hosts only.

secret.description: Optional HMAC signing secret for generic webhooks.
